headline: Not on this Sunday, 25 October 2026
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page says "THE CAR BOOT IS CLOSED THIS SUNDAY THE 25TH", so there is no sale on Sunday 25 October 2026. The farm gives no reason for the call-off and has not said anything about the Sundays after it, so do not assume the sale is either off or on beyond this date. Sales are weather dependent and the farm posts each week's notice at the top of its own car boot page, so check there before setting off; you can also call 01932 244 822 for a recorded message confirming whether a sale is taking place. Note too that the farm's own FAQ limits the season to "every Sunday from early March, through to the Autumn", so late-autumn and winter Sundays are not guaranteed even in good weather.
